errors.text_span: Die Eurozone wird durch eine schwarz gepunktete Linie dargestellt.
errors.evidence: The legend indicates that the Eurozone is represented by a black dashed line ('--- Eurozone'), while Belgium is represented by a black dotted line ('... Belgien'). The description incorrectly swaps these.
The starting value for Belgium in 1995 is approximately 130%, not 95%.
The starting value for Ireland in 1995 is approximately 80%, not 60%.
The starting value for Spain in 1995 is approximately 63%, not 50%.
The starting value for Italy in 1995 is approximately 120%, not 75%.
The ending value for Belgium in 2025 is approximately 108%, which is a significant deviation from the stated 120%.
The ending value for Ireland in 2025 is approximately 40%, not 95%. This is a very large error.
The ending value for Greece in 2025 is approximately 150%, not 120%.
The ending value for Italy in 2025 is approximately 140%, not 125%.

errors.text_span: Die Linie für Griechenland zeigt einen starken Anstieg von etwa 90 im Jahr 2008 auf über 200 im Jahr 2014
errors.evidence: The value for Greece in 2008 was approximately 110%, not 90%. Furthermore, the value in 2014 was approximately 180%; it did not exceed 200% until around 2020.
The description omits the Eurozone, a key benchmark series, from the list of starting and ending values for the different lines.
